name: service-coordinator-tool
description: Daily operations tool for a Home Care Service Coordinator. Reads a Google Sheet, generates the day's task queue automatically.

scripts.build: vite build --config vite.pages.config.ts && node scripts/verify-no-live-urls.mjs dist/index.html dist/assets/*.js
scripts.build:single: vite build --config vite.single.config.ts && node scripts/verify-no-live-urls.mjs dist-single/index.html
scripts.build:site: vite build --config vite.docs.config.ts && node scripts/verify-no-live-urls.mjs docs/index.html
